narr: A nearly stationary complex of showers and thunderstorms sat over parts of western Kentucky for several hours during the evening of the 18th. The rainfall occurred along a nearly stationary frontal boundary that extended from west to east across Kentucky.
ev: A vehicle was swept 200 yards off a road into Damon Creek near the intersection of Backusburg Road and Cavett Road. The driver was rescued by a swift water rescue team. A mesonet site near Wingo in nearby Graves County measured about 3.5 inches of rain in about 3 hours and 30 minutes.
